title: ConfigEntryContribution
description: A single configuration entry parsed from a config artifact (application.yaml, .env, kubernetes manifests, terraform vars, ...). Identity is (path, key).

path.description: Repo-relative path to the config file.

key.description: Dotted/slash key path within the file.

value.description: Raw value (any JSON type). Secret-detection / redaction is vendor-side.

secretSuspected.description: Vendor-side heuristic flag; the value MAY be redacted when true.
